title: Sage class-group Rust dispatch
objective: Connect admitted cubic number fields to the production Rust class-group service through an injectable coarse synchronous callback, preserving Sage proof semantics, cache separation, exact public class/unit objects, fractional-ideal maps, typed fallback, and unconditional upgrade

oracles: Existing Minkowski unconditional path, detached Rust replay, and public ideal-map differentials

handoff.summary: Added proof-aware automatic/forced Rust dispatch for admitted cubic class groups and class/unit projections. The Python session uses the frozen runtime.class_group_backend().call operation boundary, validates artifact and resident identities, injects exact arbitrary-ideal queries into public objects, caches conditional and unconditional authority separately, and permits auto fallback only for a typed pre-publication capability decline. proof=False may return the canonical conditional-GRH result; proof=True and proof=None authenticate that prefix and require the existing unconditional Minkowski suffix.
